start_here: Say to your AI: "Read my treg balance for team 42 and show the last 5 charges." It runs tool:read-my-treg-balance with {"account":"service_connection:treg","team_id":42,"limit":5}.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your treg team's prepaid balance and recent charges and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Get your team number with tool:read-my-treg-team (its org_id).
2. Say to your AI: "Read my treg balance for team <number>". It calls tools:run with tool tool:read-my-treg-balance, account, team_id and optionally limit (1 to 100, default 20).
3. Read balance_micro (millionths of a US dollar; 12000000 is 12 dollars), blocks, holds (amounts held for tasks still running) and the recent charges.
4. Read it before a run's first paid call and after each step; what the run spent is the first balance less the last.

worked_examples.title: Read a 12 dollar balance with 5 charges
worked_examples.ask: Read my treg balance for team 42.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/treg/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://treg.to/orgs/42/balance?limit=5 with your token in X-Treg-Token and returns treg's reply unchanged; balance_micro is the field its output_schema requires. Values are a synthetic sample.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"balance_micro":12000000,"blocks":[],"holds":[]}, plus the 5 most recent charges as treg sends them. 12000000 millionths is 12.00 US dollars.
